title: How Can I Recove Party HP and MP Through an Event?

posts.author: Mikeits
posts.body: Howdy guys, I'm new to RPG Maker. I already tried searching through old posts, but I've not been able to find a solution that works. I'm trying to figure out how to restore my party's HP and MP through meals in a restaurant. I've tried using the Change HP and Change MP commands. I've misunderstood how variables work and this is part of the issue. For example when I go to Change HP and set the actor to the entire party and for the operand variable I tried using "b.mhp * 0.20" to try and restore 20% of the parties HP. That didn't work. The only other thing I can think to try at this point are custom scripts, but I have no knowledge on coding. Does anyone have any recommendations or advice? At this point I'll take an introductory course for Java.

posts.author: Jorel
posts.body:
Hey,
@Mikeits
, I've got a non-script solution for you. You will have to recover each party member's HP one at a time instead of using Recover All, but it accomplishes the same purpose as you wanted.
To recover 20% of each party member's HP, I get their Max HP, divide it by 5, then use Change HP, repeating for each actor in the party.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
Mikeits said:
Can you explain how I need to change that code to make it work for each occasion?
Click to expand...
You put in a script call
$gameParty.members().forEach(function(m){ m.gainHp(Math.round(1*(m.mhp))); m.gainMp(Math.round(1*(m.mmp))); });
And change the 1 to the decimal of the percentage you want to recover (.25 for 25 percent). Delete the m.gainHP or m.gainMP line if you only want to recover one or the other.
